pricing.rationale: Pay per click (verifiable without trusting a pixel). Market price to win a page view on these hosts: $0.49-$0.64 per click (median $0.55), from the simulated auction against the other campaigns. 'balanced' bidding tries to win up to 60% of each host's page views; the planned bid per host is the price that wins its planned share.

allocations.rationale: market price $0.47-$0.63 (median $0.53); bidding $0.37 wins ~4% of page views, paying ~$0.34 per click (second price)
